capabilities: Count occurrences of watchlisted words across vault, note, or folder scopes
Rank most-used words with a clickable note breakdown
Visualize words and shared notes in a 3D galaxy graph
Filter results with stopwords, folder excludes, and tokenization settings
Rescan the vault after changing tokenization settings
extras: The manifest description carries the standard notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; docs link out to separate Install, Usage, Support, and Changelog pages.
problem: Obsidian's search shows matches per query but doesn't continuously track usage counts for a chosen set of words or rank overall word frequency.
summary: Word-frequency tracker that counts a watchlist of words across the vault, current note, or folder, with a most-used leaderboard and a 3D graph.
